featured_reviews.name: Swanand Kulkarni
featured_reviews.review_text:
Not at all surprised to see so many 1 star reviews already. So here’s another one.

These days it feels like they are in the mood to pitch Kodak’s anti-fatigue lenses ONLY. So, during eye check up; their line of questions, explanations, every single answer will slowly guide you to purchase the Kodak lenses. Don’t fall for it.

We visited for new specs and number check. Initially everything looked fine. But when we asked them to share the check up readings with us; they simply denied. I get it; we may take the eye reading from them and take our business somewhere else - but we are their customers since 2021 and bought multiple items. How about you consider creating an exception? Also, it’s an open market, there are other players who are operating in the same market who are maintaining high transparency with their customers and sharing every single detail. And these people were not even ready to listen to our reasons; before I even complete the sentence; they had their answer ready as to why it cannot be done! Horrible approach.

Be a smart customer - take second opinion and give your business to someone who is more friendly, approachable and easy to do business with.

featured_reviews.name: a turing
featured_reviews.review_text:
this is going to be a long review.
The quality of the products is cheap compared to price and noone from the shop will agree that their products will be faulty. Over the course of December 2020 - December 2021 I have bought over ₹10000 worth of spectacles with bills to prove it. One such recent purchase was done in December 2021. Out of blue the frame cracked today with one lens landing in my lap, Immediately went to the shop. Owner is not ready to agree that the product was faulty and kept insisting that I might have mishandled the specs. On the closer inspection of the frame I found many micro cracks are developing in the frame at random spots. I take good care of my specs and have my past spes to show it, but you cant take much care when the product is faulty from the start. I even have specs from 5 years back in top condition with minimal wear. Even after spending over 10k at the shop, today had to pay for the mistake that isn't even my fault. My current lenses were fitted crudely in the new frame and handed to me. Really disappointed as a regular customer who has been buying for entire family from the same place for over 9 years. Either the products should match the price or the suppliers need to be changed.
Only silver lining being the owner was not rude during this.
I still support the view that we should make as much of our purchases from local business as possible, but my recent experience is doing nothing to solidify that view.
